visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dead, silver-colored fish with a dark dorsal area lies on a weathered, damp concrete surface next to several yellow-brown bamboo stalks arranged in parallel. The camera provides a close-up, high-angle view. (2) A pair of hands enters the frame, using a metal ring to pry open the fish's mouth, revealing a row of sharp, white, triangular teeth. The skin around the mouth is pulled back to show the internal structure of the jaw. (3) A woman with black hair, wearing a ring, holds the fish up near her face. She smiles and points towards the fish's open mouth, showing the teeth to the camera. The background is a dark, indoor or covered area with structural beams. (4) A fish hangs suspended from a thin fishing line over a murky green river. A caiman surfaces from the water, lunging upward with its mouth wide open to snap at the bait, creating a large splash. (5) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the river. A caiman swims slowly toward the dangling fish bait. Dense green vegetation and skeletal branches are visible in the background and foreground. (6) A slow-motion sequence shows the caiman repeatedly lunging at the fish as it is jerked away. The caiman's eyes and snout are prominently visible as it breaks the surface. (7) The caiman finally catches the fish in its jaws and dives back into the water, leaving a ripple pattern on the green-tinted surface. The camera follows the movement across the water.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是食人魚, 讓我來看看他的嘴巴在哪. (2) [Subtitle]: 哇噻, 原來他的牙齒長在裡面. (3) [Subtitle]: 這就是食人魚, 太可怕了, 你們看看他的牙齒, 天吶, 他應該已經死了. (4) [Subtitle]: 抓完食人魚之後, 我們就去餵凱門鱷, 把剛才的食人魚當成是引誘他的食物. (5) [Subtitle]: 哇塞, 你有沒有看到那一下? 凱門鱷的咬合力真的很驚人.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a calm, narrative Mandarin tone, explaining the fish species. The environment is relatively quiet with faint outdoor room tone. (2) A sharp, metallic clicking and scraping sound occurs as the metal tool makes contact with the fish's teeth. The female voice raises her pitch and intensity, expressing excitement and surprise. (3) The female voice continues with moderate speed and clarity. (4) A loud, broadband splash sound with high transient energy occurs as a large object hits the water. (5) Multiple male voices enter the mix, speaking an unidentified foreign language (Portuguese/Spanish) with high vocal arousal, shouting and laughing. (6) Repeated splashing sounds and the sound of water churning are dominant, synchronized with the movement of the aquatic predator. The female voice returns with an excited, high-pitched reaction.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the physical characteristics of a piranha and demonstrate its use as bait to observe the predatory behavior of caimans in a river environment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines educational close-ups with dynamic action shots of wildlife feeding. The slow-motion editing emphasizes the power and speed of the caiman's bite.
